Mission Local’s “People We Meet: In line for Zelda at GameStop” is about three friends who arrived at the Mission Street GameStop at 6 a.m. for the release of “The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom.” They brought folding chairs and coffee, worked remotely while they waited, and were first in line for the collector’s edition. One called waiting in person for a game a “dying tradition.”
